## Scope and biological question

Using the **UT reference transcriptome**, we ask whether LPS-associated isoform switching in **UBL5 knockout (U)** differs from **wildtype THP1 (T)**.

This report:

1. Ranks significant switching genes in `T_UT` and `U_UT` (same q / |dIF| rules as elsewhere).
2. Classifies genes as **Shared**, **T-only**, or **U-only**.
3. Matches isoforms by `isoform_id` for delta-dIF / concordance statistics.
4. Provides visual overlap summaries and **gene-level explorer** panels (side-by-side T vs U dIF).
5. Includes IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR switch plots for showcase genes.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)

PROJECT_ROOT <- normalizePath("..", mustWork = TRUE)
tab <- function(...) file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "results", "tables", ...)
fig <- function(...) file.path("..", "results", "figures", "ut_t_vs_u", ...)
gene_fig <- function(...) file.path("..", "results", "figures", "ut_t_vs_u", "gene_explorer", ...)
switch_fig <- function(...) file.path("..", "results", "figures", "ut_t_vs_u", "switch_plots", ...)
```

```{r}
#| label: load
need <- c(
  "ut_T_vs_U_stats_summary.csv",
  "ut_gene_overlap_T_vs_U_summary.csv",
  "ut_gene_overlap_T_vs_U.csv",
  "ut_isoform_overlap_T_vs_U_significant.csv",
  "ut_T_vs_U_fisher_gene_contingency.csv",
  "top_switching_genes_T_UT.csv",
  "top_switching_genes_U_UT.csv",
  "ut_gene_explorer_index.csv",
  "ut_switch_plot_index.csv"
)
abs_need <- vapply(need, tab, character(1))
miss <- abs_need[!file.exists(abs_need)]
if (length(miss)) {
  stop("Missing UT comparison outputs. Run: Rscript scripts/04_comparison_T_vs_U.R\n", paste(miss, collapse = "\n"))
}

stats <- read.csv(abs_need[[1]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
gsum <- read.csv(abs_need[[2]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
gover <- read.csv(abs_need[[3]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
isig <- read.csv(abs_need[[4]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
ftab <- read.csv(abs_need[[5]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
top_t <- read.csv(abs_need[[6]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
top_u <- read.csv(abs_need[[7]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
gidx <- read.csv(abs_need[[8]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
sidx <- read.csv(abs_need[[9]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
```

## Statistical summary

```{r}
knitr::kable(stats, digits = 4, caption = "UT T vs U statistical summary")
```

Key interpretation cues:

- **Gene overlap counts / Jaccard**: shared vs genotype-specific switching genes.
- **Fisher odds ratio / p (both-present background)**: among gene symbols observed in *both* T_UT and U_UT, are significant calls co-enriched?
- **Spearman rho** on shared-significant isoform dIF: concordance of effect sizes when both are significant.
- **Binomial test**: whether shared-significant isoforms more often change in the **same direction**.
- **Wilcoxon / Kruskal**: whether |dIF| / delta-dIF distributions differ by class.

### Gene-significance contingency (genes present in both UT datasets)

```{r}
knitr::kable(ftab, caption = "Contingency of significant switching genes among both-present symbols (T_sig × U_sig)")
```

## Shared vs unique genes

### Shared genes (first 40)

```{r}
shared <- gover |>
  filter(.data$overlap_class == "Shared (T and U)") |>
  arrange(desc(.data$max_abs_dif_either)) |>
  head(40) |>
  select(
    gene_name, T_max_abs_dif, U_max_abs_dif, delta_max_abs_dif,
    T_n_switching, U_n_switching, T_min_q, U_min_q,
    T_novel_involved, U_novel_involved
  )
knitr::kable(shared, digits = 4, caption = "Shared significant genes (top by max |dIF|)")
```

### T-only (first 30)

```{r}
t_only <- gover |>
  filter(.data$overlap_class == "T-only") |>
  arrange(desc(.data$T_max_abs_dif)) |>
  head(30) |>
  select(gene_name, T_max_abs_dif, T_n_switching, T_min_q, T_novel_involved, T_opposing)
knitr::kable(t_only, digits = 4, caption = "T-only significant genes")
```

### U-only (first 30)

```{r}
u_only <- gover |>
  filter(.data$overlap_class == "U-only") |>
  arrange(desc(.data$U_max_abs_dif)) |>
  head(30) |>
  select(gene_name, U_max_abs_dif, U_n_switching, U_min_q, U_novel_involved, U_opposing)
knitr::kable(u_only, digits = 4, caption = "U-only significant genes")
```

## Gene-level explorer

Each panel shows isoform dIF for the same gene in **T_UT** and **U_UT** (novel isoforms tagged `(PB)`).

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Gene explorer panels (subset by overlap class)"
#| out-width: "100%"
ok <- gidx[!is.na(gidx$figure) & nzchar(gidx$figure), , drop = FALSE]
show <- ok |>
  group_by(.data$overlap_class) |>
  slice_head(n = 6) |>
  ungroup()
paths <- vapply(show$figure, gene_fig, character(1))
exist_abs <- file.path(
  PROJECT_ROOT, "results", "figures", "ut_t_vs_u", "gene_explorer", show$figure
)
keep <- file.exists(exist_abs)
if (any(keep)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(paths[keep])
} else {
  knitr::asis_output("_No gene explorer figures found._\n")
}
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  show[, c("gene_name", "overlap_class", "figure", "T_max_abs_dif", "U_max_abs_dif")],
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Gene explorer figures included above"
)
```

## Switch plots (showcase)

ISA `switchPlot` panels (gene symbols + PB labels when available).

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Showcase switchPlots for shared / T-only / U-only genes"
#| out-width: "100%"
ok <- sidx
ok$ok_flag <- ok$ok %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE", "true", 1, "1")
ok <- ok[!is.na(ok$figure) & nzchar(ok$figure) & ok$ok_flag, , drop = FALSE]
show_sw <- ok |>
  group_by(.data$overlap_class, .data$dataset) |>
  slice_head(n = 3) |>
  ungroup()
paths_sw <- vapply(show_sw$figure, switch_fig, character(1))
exist_sw <- file.path(
  PROJECT_ROOT, "results", "figures", "ut_t_vs_u", "switch_plots", show_sw$figure
)
keep_sw <- file.exists(exist_sw)
if (any(keep_sw)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(paths_sw[keep_sw])
} else {
  knitr::asis_output("_No switch plots found._\n")
}
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  show_sw[, c("gene_name", "overlap_class", "dataset", "figure")],
  caption = "Switch plots included above"
)
```

## Methods notes

- Significance uses `config/config.yml` thresholds (`isoform_q`, `gene_q`, optional `min_abs_dif`).
- **Gene overlap** uses cleaned gene symbols (not `XLOC_*` / `ENSG*`), because those IDs are not stably shared across condition objects.
- **Isoform matching** uses `isoform_id` (`TCONS`) within the UT reference; many isoforms are unique to one genotype’s ISA output, so “missing in U/T” is an informative category.
- Rebuild:

```bash
Rscript scripts/04_comparison_T_vs_U.R
quarto render reports/ut_t_vs_u_comparison.qmd
```
